title: Context Metabolism / Cross-Repo Gem Harvest
objective: Reduce already-selected OTHRYS evidence into minimal deterministic transport capsules while preserving required evidence, authority evidence and frozen identities; quarry old OTHRYS and VTC for proven efficiency patterns before implementation.
problem: Current OTHRYS selects relevant context but still carries more evidence bytes than some consumers require, and high-value production patterns remain scattered across historical Core/Hub/VTC lineage.
outOfScope: No AI context summarizer or learned relevance authority
No change to Mnemosyne knowledge authority or search ranking
No mutation of VTC, dirty Hub, or old Core worktrees
risks: historical duplicate code is mistaken for a new subsystem
laws: Mnemosyne decides what belongs; Context Metabolism only decides how much selected evidence travels.
Required evidence lost = 0; authority evidence lost = 0; frozen identity expansion = 0.
Compression must be real reference substitution or eviction; never pretend bytes became smaller.
Ungrounded or corroborated repetition cannot outrank canonical or grounded evidence.
VTC and historical repos are quarry/provenance only; current V2 law remains authoritative.

tasks.title: Compare old OTHRYS/VTC production patterns against current V2

Prove zero required/authority evidence loss, no identity expansion and deterministic reduction
